info.title: Organyz Work API
info.description: Organyz Work Project Management API - Manage projects, tasks, labels, and more

ApiKeyRateLimited.description: The API key exceeded its rate limit or usage quota. Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After before retrying. The X-RateLimit headers are sent only when the rate limit was hit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Omitted when an exhausted usage quota never refills.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the API key may make per window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds when the current window resets.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code. Derived from the status unless a more specific code applies, such as VALIDATION_ERROR or MISSING_PERMISSION.

path.description: Dotted path to the invalid input, prefixed with the request part (body, query, params, header).

missingPermissions.description: Permissions the caller lacks for this route, as resource:action, for MISSING_PERMISSION and API_KEY_SCOPE.

descriptionDeferred.description: True when the list omits a large description; load the task detail or description pages to read it. Do not replace stored text with this null summary.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

estimate.description: Points on the team's estimate scale (see the project's estimateOptions). Null when unestimated.

startedAt.description: When the task last entered a started status; cleared when it moves back before started.

completedAt.description: When the task entered a completed status; null unless completed.

canceledAt.description: When the task entered a canceled status; null unless canceled.

slaDueAt.description: The task's SLA deadline; null when the team's SLA rules do not apply.

startedTriageAt.description: When the task most recently entered triage.

triagedAt.description: When the task last left triage; null while in triage.

statusSince.description: When the task entered its current status: its latest status change, or its creation if it never moved. Null on public boards.

subtaskCounts.description: Direct subtasks in the workspace; completed means a final column in the child project. Public boards count only children in public projects.

interval.description: Repeat every this many days, weeks, months, or years.

weekdays.description: Weekly rules only: the days to repeat on, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. Without them, a weekly rule repeats on the due date's weekday.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to keep the next due date on the same local day and time.

TaskRecurrence.description: When a task with this rule moves into a final column, the next task is created with its dates moved forward by one interval from the completed task's due date.

metadata.description: Provider-specific payload, already parsed from the stored JSON string.

relatedRevision.description: Public board labels and external links revision for this task page. Restart pagination if it changes during related-page continuations.

revision.description: Public board content, membership and ordering revision, including related records and visible subtask progress. Restart pagination if it changes between task or related pages.

BoardPagination.description: Always paginated: 50 tasks by default, at most 100 per page. Continue through totalPages to retrieve all tasks. For each task page, follow relatedPage through relatedTotalPages to retrieve all labels, external links and columns (100 related rows per kind per request, plus up to 100 columns needed to represent the tasks).

descriptionDeferred.description: True when a project description above 64 KiB is omitted; use project detail or public project description pages for full text.

instanceName.description: Name shown in page titles and emails. Defaults to Organyz Work.

disabledIntegrations.description: Integration provider types an administrator turned off, such as `slack`.

hasImageUploads.description: Whether S3-compatible storage is configured, so task images and board backgrounds can be uploaded.

customOAuthName.description: Label for the custom OAuth provider on the sign-in page. Null means the generic SSO label.

customOAuthManagedProfileFields.description: Profile fields the custom OAuth/OIDC provider manages for people with a linked provider account.

customOAuthAccountUrl.description: Account page of the custom OAuth/OIDC provider, where people change managed profile fields. Null when not configured.

hasAgent.description: Whether the agent and loops are available (an OpenRouter API key or a self-hosted model URL is configured).

hasCalls.description: Whether voice and video calls are available (a LiveKit server is configured).

hasFigmaPreviews.description: Whether Figma links show as cards with a thumbnail (a Figma access token is configured). Without it they stay plain links.

documentCoediting.description: Whether several people can edit a document at once with live cursors (DOCUMENT_COEDITING_KEY is set). Without it, a save made over a newer version asks first.

redirect.description: Where to send the browser next: back to the client with a code on approval, or with an error on denial.

idToken.description: The stored id_token for the user's `custom` OAuth account, or null when they have no such account.

estimateOptions.description: The points an issue can take on this team's estimate scale; empty when estimates are off.

slug.description: Short prefix used in task identifiers, e.g. KAN-12.

isPublic.description: When true the project's board is readable without signing in, via /api/public-project/{id}.

isPrivate.description: When true only the team's members, the workspace owner and instance administrators can open the team.

archivedAt.description: Non-null once archived; archived projects are hidden by default.

lastTaskNumber.description: Highest task number issued in this project; the next task gets this plus one.

memberCount.description: Workspace members who can open this team.

dueDate.description: The soonest due date among the project's open tasks.

joined.description: False once you left the team. Leaving only hides it from your sidebar.

notifyIssueAdded.description: Notify you when an issue is added to the team.

notifyIssueClosed.description: Notify you when an issue is completed or canceled.

notifyIssueTriage.description: Notify you when an issue is added to the triage queue.

joined.description: False leaves the team: it drops out of your sidebar and its subscriptions are cleared. Access to the team's issues is unchanged.

userIds.description: The workspace members added to the private team. The workspace owner and instance administrators can open every team and are not listed.

total.description: All open tasks assigned to the caller, including any beyond the first 100 returned.

status.description: The slug of the column the task sits in.

statusName.description: The column's display name. Null for tasks outside a column, such as planned ones.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

position.description: The task's manual position in its column.

inCycle.description: Whether the task is in its team's running cycle.

lastActivityAt.description: The caller's latest activity on the task. Set on the activity tab only.

reviewRequestedAt.description: When the caller was asked to review the task's design. Set on the review tab only.

reviewSlaDueAt.description: When the caller's design review is due: two days after the request. Set on the review tab only.

blockedBy.description: Open tasks that block this one, as keys such as ENG-12. Blockers in teams you cannot open are left out.

hasHiddenBlocker.description: Whether an open task in a team you cannot open blocks this one. It says nothing about how many.

key.description: Object key to send back to the finalize route.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned URL to PUT the image bytes to.

headers.description: Headers that must accompany the upload request, including Content-Type.

url.description: Where the stored image can be read back from.

descriptionDeferred.description: True when the list omits a large description; load the task detail or description pages to read it. Do not replace stored text with this null summary.

status.description: The slug of the column the task sits in.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

estimate.description: Points on the team's estimate scale (see the project's estimateOptions). Null when unestimated.

completedAt.description: When the task entered a completed status; null unless completed.

creatorId.description: The user who created the task, if known.

snoozedUntil.description: Triage snooze: the task resurfaces in triage after this time.

slaDueAt.description: The task's SLA deadline; null when the team's SLA rules do not apply.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the task's project.
The workspace currently owning the task's project. Included in the detail view; omitted from the compact board view.

columnId.description: The referenced workflow column; null for virtual statuses and legacy tasks without a column reference.

isSubscribed.description: Whether the caller follows the task. Detail view only.

statusSince.description: When the task entered its current status: its latest status change, or its creation if it never moved. Board view only.

canceledAt.description: When the task entered a canceled status; null unless canceled. Detail view only.

status.description: Status slug as recorded when the task held it. A renamed or removed column keeps its old slug.

name.description: Current name of the project column with this slug; null when no single column matches.

totalMs.description: Total milliseconds spent in this status.

current.description: True for the task's current status.

labels.description: Label names and colors, without their ids.

tasks.description: Per-task outcome, each carrying a success flag.

slug.description: Stable identifier derived from the name; tasks store this as their status.

position.description: Board order, ascending. Columns are always returned sorted by it.

isFinal.description: Marks the column as a done state, which stops overdue reminders for tasks in it.

type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed, cycle_changed, labels_changed, work_project_changed, parent_changed, duplicate_changed, created_from_chat_message, chat_message_added.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload. For status_changed, oldStatus/newStatus are slugs and oldStatusName/newStatusName carry current configured column names when available.

excerpt.description: Plain-text preview of the stored content, at most 240 characters: the comment body, or the description older system events carry instead of eventData.

reactions.description: Emoji reactions on a comment, in the order each emoji was first used.

createdIssues.description: Tasks created from this comment that you can see, oldest first. Empty on events.

subscribedToThread.description: Whether you follow this comment's thread. Set on top-level comments only; null on replies and events.

isSubIssue.description: Whether the task has a parent task.

type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed, cycle_changed, labels_changed, work_project_changed, parent_changed, duplicate_changed, created_from_chat_message, chat_message_added.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload, e.g. { oldStatus, newStatus } for status_changed. Null for plain comments.

externalUserName.description: Set when the activity was imported from another tool.

externalSource.description: The tool it was imported from: planka, trello, jira, plane, linear, kaneo, or a connected forge such as github.

parentId.description: The top-level comment this reply belongs to. Null for top-level comments and events.

resolvedAt.description: Set on a top-level comment when its thread is resolved.

resolvingCommentId.description: The reply shown as the thread's resolution. Null when resolved from the top-level comment.

parentId.description: The top-level comment this reply belongs to.

userId.description: Null once the user who logged the time has been removed.

endTime.description: Null while the timer is still running.

duration.description: Elapsed seconds, filled in once the entry has an endTime.

projectIds.description: The teams events come from, among those the caller can open. Empty with no hidden teams means every team.

hiddenProjectCount.description: How many teams in the filter the caller cannot open. They are kept when the caller saves the filter.

total.description: Issues in the cycle, canceled and archived excluded.

completed.description: Issues finished when the cycle ended.

addedAfterStart.description: Issues that joined the cycle after it started.

carriedOver.description: Issues still open when the cycle ended.

summary.description: Team totals snapshotted when the cycle completes; null until then. Canceled and archived issues are excluded.

available.description: Whether this instance has an intake mailbox. When false, intake cannot be turned on.

repliesAvailable.description: Whether this instance can send email (SMTP) for replies.

address.description: The team's intake address, or null when intake is off for the team.

commentId.description: The comment that records the reply on the ticket.

teamIds.description: The project's teams that you can open.

canOpenDocuments.description: Whether you can open the project's documents and put a document in it: the project has no team, or you can open one of its teams.

dependentIds.description: Projects that wait on this project.

lastUpdateAt.description: When the latest project update was posted. Null when none.

nextMilestone.description: The earliest milestone with a target date of today or later. Null when none.

overdueCount.description: Open issues in the project past their due date, among the teams you can open.

health.description: The health of the initiative's latest update.

rolledUpHealth.description: The worst of the latest update's health and the health of the initiative's open projects that you can open.

progress.description: Issues across the initiative's projects that you can open: all of them and the done ones.

enabled.description: Show others in your workspaces when you are online in chat.

online.description: Ids of workspace members who turned presence on and are online now. Empty while your own presence is off.

unreadCount.description: Messages from others since you last read the channel. 0 for channels you have not joined.

isDirect.description: True for a direct message: private to its members, whose list never changes.

isMember.description: True when the caller has joined the channel.

aiDisabled.description: True when the channel's members turned AI features off.

isMuted.description: True when the caller muted the channel: its mentions and direct messages stop reaching their Inbox.

unreadCount.description: Messages from others since you last read the channel. 0 for channels you have not joined.

editedAt.description: When the author last edited the message. Null if never.

pinnedAt.description: When the message was pinned to its channel. Null if not.

reactions.description: Emoji reactions, in the order each emoji was first used; userIds oldest first.

files.description: Files sent with the message, oldest first. Each downloads from the channel's files/{id} route for whoever can read the channel.

mentions.description: Cards for the people, tickets, documents and teams the message names, as you see them now.

parentId.description: The message whose thread this reply sits in. Null for a message in the channel timeline.

replyCount.description: How many replies the message's thread holds.

ChatLinkPreview.description: A card for the first web link, added shortly after posting. Links inside code get none.

ref.description: How the text names it: a user, document or team id, or a ticket key such as ENG-12.

title.description: A person's or team's name, a ticket's or document's title. Null when restricted.

status.description: A ticket's status. Null for anything else.

projectId.description: The team of a ticket. Null for anything else.

restricted.description: True when you cannot open it: id, title and status are then null.

remindAt.description: When your Inbox gets the reminder. Nobody else sees it.

messageId.description: The message that shows the new ticket's card.

token.description: A LiveKit access token for this room only, valid for one minute. LiveKit renews it once connected.

remindAt.description: When the reminder reaches your Inbox.

addedBy.description: Who uploaded the file. Null once their account is gone.

id.description: The ticket, document or channel the file belongs to.

name.description: The ticket's or document's title, or the channel's name. Empty for a direct message.

projectId.description: The ticket's team. Null for documents and chat.

number.description: The ticket's number in its team. Null otherwise.

messageId.description: The chat message the file was sent with. Null otherwise.

isDirect.description: True for a file sent in a direct message.

proposals.description: The writes the agent proposed in this chat.

citations.description: On an answer: the tasks, documents and comments it rests on, checked against the reader's access when the chat is read.

unsourced.description: On an answer: true when it names no source.

taskId.description: The issue a task or a comment is on.

channelId.description: The channel a chat message is in.

AgentCitation.description: A source an answer rests on. One the reader cannot open, or that is gone, is only `restricted`, with no title or id.

toolCallId.description: The tool call in the chat transcript that proposed it.

selectable.description: True when the person may keep some fields and drop others: accept with `fields`.

result.description: On a failed proposal: what the API answered.

AgentProposal.description: A write the agent proposed. Nothing changes until the person who asked accepts it.

field.description: priority, labels, status, title, description, assignee, team, startDate, dueDate or comment.

reason.description: Why this one field is suggested, when the card says so.

messages.description: The user message plus everything the agent added: tool calls, tool results and the final reply.

days.description: How many days the lists below cover.

cost.description: US dollars the provider reported, when it did.

userDailyTokens.description: Tokens one person may use in this workspace per UTC day. Null means no limit.

workspaceMonthlyTokens.description: Tokens the whole workspace may use per UTC calendar month. Null means no limit.

kind.description: `write` is an agent write someone accepted; `setting` is an admin's change of the AI data destination (tool `set_ai_destination`).

prompt.description: The person's message the proposal came from.

toolCalls.description: The tool call that proposed the write.

result.description: What the API answered when the write ran.

provider.description: `openrouter` sends the workspace's text to OpenRouter; `self-hosted` sends it only to the model server this instance's owner configured.

model.description: The model that receives the text.

host.description: The OpenRouter host the model is pinned to, if any.

selfHosted.description: Whether the server has a self-hosted model URL (`AI_SELF_HOSTED_URL`).

canChange.description: Whether you may change the destination (admins only).

status.description: Status slugs of the team's columns.

blocked.description: Only tickets blocked by an open blocking relation.

createdAt.description: `olderThan:<days>`: created more than that many days ago.

filters.description: The board filter, or null when a question comes back.

question.description: One question back when the sentence was unclear; nothing is applied.

projectId.description: The team whose board the filter is for.

text.description: The filter in plain English, e.g. 'my blocked bugs older than 2 weeks'.

sources.description: The comments the summary rests on.

guidance.description: Sent to the model with every new triage ticket of the team, such as which labels or people handle what.

autoApply.description: Apply the suggestion without anyone accepting it. Off by default.

configured.description: False while the server has no coding agent address or key; delegation is then off.

WritingSuggestion.description: The rewritten passage. Nothing is saved.

triage.description: Ask the model for a triage suggestion on every new ticket in triage.

prSummary.description: Ask the model for a summary comment when a linked pull request merges.

AiFeatures.description: AI features that call the model on their own. All off until an admin turns them on.

projectId.description: The parent team. Null when the viewer cannot open it.

taskId.description: The parent issue. Null when the viewer cannot open its team.

parentName.description: Team name, project name or issue key of the parent.

sourceClient.description: The assistant the document was saved from, if any.

topicId.description: The topic the document is filed on. Null when you cannot open the topic.

snoozedUntil.description: The Inbox hides the document until this time. Null when it is not set aside.

canEdit.description: Whether you may edit the document, and so snooze it in the Inbox.

currentDocumentId.description: On a replaced document: the current document of its topic, if you can open it.

replacesDocumentId.description: On a proposal: the document its author means it to replace. It may no longer be current. Null when you cannot open the topic.

projectId.description: The parent team. Null when the viewer cannot open it.

taskId.description: The parent issue. Null when the viewer cannot open its team.

parentName.description: Team name, project name or issue key of the parent.

sourceClient.description: The assistant the document was saved from, if any.

topicId.description: The topic the document is filed on. Null when you cannot open the topic.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the content in UTF-8, as hex.

supersedesDocumentId.description: The document that was current on the topic before this one. On a proposal, the current document its author means it to replace.

statusReason.description: The reason given when the document was made current.

approvedHash.description: The contentHash that was approved. It differs once the text is edited.

approvedVersionId.description: The history entry that keeps the approved text.

overlap.description: How much of the two texts is the same, in percent of all five-word runs.

status.description: proposed until a person confirms or dismisses the link. It is a hint and changes no status.

revisionOf.description: The older document this text looks like a revision of. Null when there is none the reader can open.

citedBy.description: Issues linked with the document, in the text of either. Only issues you can open.

sharedTasks.description: Issues the document is shared with that you can open: everyone who can open one can view the document. An issue you cannot open is left out, also with edit rights.

hiddenSharedTaskCount.description: With edit rights: how many issues you cannot open the document is also shared with. Their ids and names stay hidden. Zero without edit rights.

ancestors.description: The pages above this one, top first. It starts below the nearest page you cannot open.

hasChildren.description: Whether any page sits under this one.

characters.description: How long the stored text is. The text is not sent back.

created.description: False when the key was used before and nothing was saved.

needsDecision.description: True while the author has not said what the draft is. Ask them, then settle it.

key.description: What a statement names the slot by.

options.description: The values an enum slot may take.

slots.description: The facts this topic keeps, such as a date or a price. A statement gives one slot's value as a document states it.

topics.description: Topics the author can open whose name matches the title, each with its current document.

overlap.description: How much of the two texts is the same, in percent of all five-word runs.

status.description: proposed until a person confirms or dismisses the link. It is a hint and changes no status.

revisionOf.description: The older document this text looks like a revision of. Null when there is none the reader can open.

replacesDocumentId.description: The current document the author means this one to replace. It stays current until the topic's decider approves this one.

result.description: added: stored as a proposal. unknown_slot: the topic has no slot with that key. quote_not_found: the quote is not in the document, or is shorter than 4 characters. invalid_value: the value does not fit the slot. exists: the slot already has a statement from this document.

statements.description: What happened to each statement sent, in the order sent. A refused statement does not undo the filing.

quoteStart.description: Where the quote starts in the document's text, with tags removed and whitespace collapsed.

status.description: proposed until a person confirms or rejects it. A confirmation is for the text it was given on: after an edit the statement is proposed again.

needsReview.description: True from the moment the topic stops stating the value, until someone clears the flag.

parentDocumentId.description: The page it sits under. Null at the top, and when you cannot open that page.

confirmed.description: A person confirmed this statement for the document's present text.

current.description: What the topic's current document states for the slot.

repeats.description: Says the same as the topic's current document.

confirmed.description: A person confirmed this statement for the document's present text.

new.description: The topic's current document states nothing for the slot.

conflicts.description: Says something else than the topic's current document, each with both quotes.

confirmed.description: A person confirmed this statement for the document's present text.

current.description: What the topic's current document states for the slot.

unjudged.description: Worded differently from the current document, in a slot that holds free text. Nobody has judged whether the two disagree.

notChecked.description: Slots of the topic the document has no statement for.

suggestedTickets.description: A ticket per change: each conflict, unless the decider said the two do not contradict each other, and each new fact. A person accepts each one on its own.

confirmed.description: A person confirmed this statement for the document's present text.

current.description: What the topic's current document states for the slot.

id.description: Names the slot, the two documents and the two values. When a value changes, it is another conflict with another id.

status.description: open: the document cannot be made current. tolerated: the two may differ until tolerateUntil. resolved: the decider said the document's value stands, or that the two do not contradict each other.

key.description: Names the slot, the document and the value. An edit elsewhere in the text keeps it.

kind.description: change: the value differs from the current document. new: the current document states nothing for the slot.

accepted.description: Someone accepted it, and the ticket was made.

ticket.description: The ticket made from it. Null until it is accepted, and for a ticket in a team the caller cannot enter.

creatorId.description: The author who left. Null when they deleted their account. Hand the documents over with it.

deletedAt.description: When the author put it in the trash. Null when they did not. A hand-over leaves it here; taking it over brings it out of the trash.

url.description: Where the file is read from. It opens for whoever can open the issue.

proposedDocumentId.description: The document made from this file on the topic, when you can open one.

topics.description: The topics the issue is on that you can open.

current.description: Workspace members who can open the document now.

proposed.description: Members who could open it in the place asked about. Null when no place was asked about.

topicsWithCurrent.description: Topics that have a current document.

added.description: Documents added in the week that are not in the trash.

filed.description: How many of the added documents were filed on a topic.

chatSaves.description: How many of the added documents an assistant saved.

weeks.description: The last four weeks, newest first. A week is seven days back from the time of the call.

state.description: The merged Yjs state, base64. Null when the document has none for its current text: seed it from `content`.

contentHash.description: The `contentHash` of the document's current text.

content.description: The current text to seed from, when `state` is null.

snoozedUntil.description: The Inbox hides the document until this time. Null when it is not set aside.

total.description: Workspace members who can open the issue.

missing.description: How many of them cannot open the document.

gains.description: The people who cannot open the document. Sharing it with the issue lets them view it.

url.description: Where the file is read back from. It opens for whoever can open the document.

kind.description: image for a picture, attachment for any other file.

parentName.description: Team or project name. Null for a workspace topic.

currentDocumentTitle.description: Title of the current document. Null when nothing is current, or when you cannot open that document.

hasReplaced.description: Whether a document on the topic was ever replaced, so the topic has a history even when nothing is current now.

canDecide.description: Whether you can make a document current here: the decider, the backup decider or a workspace owner.

canManage.description: Whether you can rename the topic and name its decider and backup: the decider or a workspace owner.

following.description: Whether you follow the topic: you are told about a new proposal and a new current document.

topicId.description: The topic of the slot. Its current answers say what holds now.

dependsOn.description: The statement the work relies on.

topicId.description: The topic of the slot. Its current answers say what holds now.

cause.description: The statement whose change raised the flag. Another one than dependsOn when the flag came down a chain of documents. Null when it sits in a place the reader cannot open.

parentName.description: Team or project name. Null for a workspace topic.

tasks.description: The issues on the topic that you can open. An issue in a team you cannot enter is left out.

unreviewed.description: How many documents wait for a decision on this topic. None of them is approved.

key.description: What a statement names the slot by.

options.description: The values an enum slot may take.

slots.description: The facts this topic keeps, such as a date or a price. A statement gives one slot's value as a document states it.

statementId.description: The statement behind the value. Work that relies on the value is linked to it. Null when value is null.

value.description: What the current document states for the slot, confirmed by a person for the text that was approved. Null when nobody confirmed a value for the slot: the approved text may still state one.

quote.description: The words of the approved text the value rests on.

proposedIn.description: Documents that wait for a decision and state something for the slot. Titles only: none of them is approved.

answers.description: One answer per slot of the topic, from what was approved. Only a current document you can open answers.

reason.description: Why the decider made this document current.

editedSinceApproval.description: The document was edited after it was approved. `text` is still what was approved.

text.description: The approved text as it is stored. Null when more than one topic matches: ask again with one topic's id. Also null when the approved text was not kept.

current.description: The topic's current document. Null when nothing is approved on the topic.

closed.description: The issue is completed, canceled or archived.

parentName.description: Team or project name. Null for a workspace topic.

tasks.description: The issues on the topic that you can open. An issue in a team you cannot enter is left out.

value.description: The value the work relies on.

statedIn.description: The id of the document that states it. Removing the link needs it.

needsReview.description: True when the value changed after the link was made and nobody looked at the work since.

key.description: What a statement names the slot by.

options.description: The values an enum slot may take.

quote.description: The words of the issue or the file that state the value.

file.description: The file on the issue the words are from. Empty when they are from the issue's own text or a comment.

onTopic.description: The issue is already on this topic.

content.description: Free-text body. Null for generated notifications, whose text the client renders from type and eventData.

type.description: One of: info, task_created, workspace_created, task_status_changed, task_assignee_changed, time_entry_created, due_date_reminder, task_overdue, task_mention, task_comment, chat_mention, chat_direct_message.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload, e.g. { taskTitle, oldStatus, newStatus, projectId, workspaceId }.

403.description: The caller lacks the instance permission or is authenticated with an API key

409.description: The session is the administrator's current session

get.description: List a user's API keys with their name, start, status, and dates. The key and its hash are never returned. Requires the `users:api_keys` instance permission; API keys are rejected.

403.description: The caller lacks the instance permission or is authenticated with an API key

delete.description: Delete a user's API key so it stops working immediately, and record it in the audit log. Requires the `users:api_keys` instance permission; API keys are rejected.

403.description: The caller lacks the instance permission or is authenticated with an API key

404.description: User or API key not found

post.description: Turn off another user's two-factor sign-in, for example after they lost their device: their authenticator secret, recovery codes and remembered devices are removed, and the reset is recorded in the audit log. Sessions are kept. If the instance requires two-factor, the next sign-in asks them to set it up again. You must have two-factor on yourself and send a current code from your authenticator app or one of your recovery codes; a session alone is refused. Your own two-factor can't be reset here. Requires the `users:credentials` instance permission; API keys are rejected.

403.description: The caller lacks the instance permission, uses an API key, has no two-factor of their own, or sent a missing or wrong code

409.description: The user is the caller

429.description: Too many wrong codes from the caller; code entry is locked for 15 minutes
